outfit.name: 新菜专属试衣交叉黑绑带泳装
outfit.prose: A minimalist matte black criss-cross wrap bikini top that accentuates her bust with silver ring hardware, paired with ultra-low strappy bottoms. Delicate leather garter straps descend from the waist to dual thigh bands, pinching gently into her sun-kissed soft thighs, barefoot.
